claim: PFD AI modernization will 'revolutionize'/'be a game changer' for processing (Fadil Limani, Alaska DOR)

sources.story_title: CLAIM SOURCE — Deputy Commissioner Fadil Limani quoted on the Saige Consulting PFD deal; also carries Saige partner Charles Hu's admission that no system runs automatically and an analyst must verify every application (counter-evidence)
CLAIM CORROBORATION + TIMELINE — system 'expected to go live early next year' (early 2026); no public launch confirmed as of June 2026
PRIMARY COUNTER-EVIDENCE — official 2026 filing-season site shows the same manual paper-upload workflow, no mention of AI or Saige
